title: Freya and the Sigil
author: Elodie Kavanagh
blurb: Oscar Hartwell, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the old gods begin answering prayers again — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
